devices.title: Use an existing account
devices.instructions: Link this installation from your signed-in player portal, or use a saved recovery code. You will review the account before switching. Existing progress stays in its original account.
devices.portal_instructions: On your existing account: Portal → Devices → Link device. Check that the fingerprints match. The request expires in five minutes.
devices.saved.preserved: Account saved. Restart the game to use it. Your previous account key is preserved on this device.
devices.saved.not_merged: Account saved. Restart the game to use it. The previous account was preserved; progress was not merged.
devices.error.start_first: Start a new device request first.
devices.error.preserve_key: Cannot preserve the previously linked device key.
devices.error.approve_first: Approve this device on the portal first.
